purpose: Evaluate bounded contextual exploration among already eligible quality-qualified marketplace candidates.
limitations: Offline inverse-propensity estimates require overlap and trustworthy logging propensities.
Contexts are allowlisted operational affinities and cannot encode identity or sensitive proxies.
Synthetic replay does not authorize production or shadow traffic.
The rolling traffic budget and hard constraints always take precedence over UCB score.
rollback: Disable contextual exploration and restore the deployed beta-Bernoulli policy or deterministic ranking with zero exploration.
